name: Word Embeddings (Word2Vec / GloVe)
when_to_use: Need for semantic similarity between words/texts beyond term counts (complements 22-tfidf); represents words as numeric vectors where words with similar meaning end up close together.
notes: Represents words as numbers so that words with similar meaning are mathematically "close". Applications: semantic search, grouping similar answers even when different words are used.

expected_input.question: Which words/texts have similar meaning, even when using different words?

plain_explanation.purpose: Turns words into numbers so that similar meanings end up close together.
plain_explanation.when_to_use_plain: When you want the computer to understand that different words can mean the same thing.
plain_explanation.data_needed: A large set of texts to learn the relationships.
plain_explanation.example: Search documents by meaning, not only by the exact word.
plain_explanation.diagram: 'car' and 'automobile' end up close; 'banana' far away
